report_metadata.purpose: LLM Performance Analysis for GPT Model Review

analysis_approach.primary_focus: Evaluate LLM performance patterns, identify strengths and weaknesses
key_questions: Is this LLM ready for production use?
What are the main quality concerns?

reporting_guidelines.structure: Provide executive summary, key findings, recommendations, and supporting details
reporting_guidelines.focus: Actionable insights rather than just metric descriptions

executive_summary.status_description: LLM performance is below production standards and requires significant improvements
top_recommendations: Improve prompt engineering to increase success rates
Consider model fine-tuning or alternative model architectures

title_diversity.name: Title Diversity
title_diversity.description: Measures how varied the generated technology trend titles are across multiple trials
title_diversity.interpretation_guide: Higher values indicate the LLM generates more unique and creative titles rather than repeating similar concepts
title_diversity.calculation_method: Ratio of unique titles to total titles generated across trials

semantic_drift.name: Semantic Drift
semantic_drift.description: Measures how much the semantic meaning changes across consecutive responses
semantic_drift.interpretation_guide: Low drift (0-30%) indicates consistent messaging; High drift (70-100%) suggests unstable or incoherent outputs
semantic_drift.calculation_method: TF-IDF cosine similarity variance between consecutive responses

confidence_cv.name: Confidence Coefficient of Variation
confidence_cv.description: Measures the relative variability of confidence scores across trials
confidence_cv.interpretation_guide: Lower CV indicates consistent confidence levels; Higher CV suggests unstable self-assessment
confidence_cv.calculation_method: Standard deviation divided by mean of confidence scores

pass_at_1.name: Pass@1 Success Rate
pass_at_1.description: Percentage of single attempts that meet quality thresholds
pass_at_1.interpretation_guide: Higher pass rates indicate reliable performance on first attempt
pass_at_1.calculation_method: Percentage of trials with confidence scores above threshold (typically 0.7)

pass_at_3.name: Pass@3 Success Rate
pass_at_3.description: Percentage of 3-attempt sequences where all attempts succeed
pass_at_3.interpretation_guide: Measures consistency across multiple attempts; Critical for production reliability
pass_at_3.calculation_method: Percentage of 3-trial groups where all trials exceed quality threshold

hallucination_risk.name: Hallucination Risk Score
hallucination_risk.description: Measures likelihood of generating false or inconsistent information
hallucination_risk.interpretation_guide: Higher scores indicate greater risk of hallucinations and factual errors
hallucination_risk.calculation_method: Variance in response similarity and numerical consistency across trials

error_rate.name: Error Rate
error_rate.description: Percentage of responses containing detectable errors (format, placeholders, truncation)
error_rate.interpretation_guide: Lower error rates indicate higher output quality and reliability
error_rate.calculation_method: Percentage of responses with format errors, placeholders, or truncation

efficiency_score.name: Efficiency Score
efficiency_score.description: Combined metric of token usage efficiency and time performance
efficiency_score.interpretation_guide: Higher scores indicate better resource utilization and faster processing
efficiency_score.calculation_method: Weighted combination of token efficiency and time efficiency normalized by success rate

latency_mean.name: Average Response Latency
latency_mean.description: Mean time taken to generate responses
latency_mean.interpretation_guide: Lower latency indicates faster processing; Critical for user experience
latency_mean.calculation_method: Average time between request and response completion

trajectory_uniqueness.name: Reasoning Trajectory Uniqueness
trajectory_uniqueness.description: Measures diversity in reasoning steps and thought processes
trajectory_uniqueness.interpretation_guide: Higher uniqueness indicates more varied and thorough reasoning approaches
trajectory_uniqueness.calculation_method: Ratio of unique reasoning steps to total steps across responses

production_readiness.name: Production Readiness Assessment
production_readiness.description: Evaluates if the LLM is ready for production deployment

content_quality.name: Content Quality Assessment
content_quality.description: Evaluates the quality and consistency of generated content

reliability.name: System Reliability Assessment
reliability.description: Evaluates consistency and predictability of LLM outputs

trend_analysis.note: Trend analysis requires temporal data across multiple time periods
trend_analysis.recommendations: Implement regular performance monitoring to enable trend analysis
